subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and authorized per-user usage view now, and if so what identity should be counted?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing a billing/accounting subject and who may view it crosses identity, privacy, and authorization boundaries in a product currently documented around a single trusted operator.

options.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer-permission model before extending usage RPCs, diagnostics, and UI around per-user totals.

options.title: Wait For Broader Principal Design
options.body: Keep this open but block implementation until Gateway multi-principal and per-message author attribution semantics are settled.

options.title: Support External Reporting For Now
options.body: Document Prometheus/plugin/ledger workarounds as custom spend-dashboard paths until core has multi-user direction.

recommendation.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer-permission model before extending usage RPCs, diagnostics, and UI around per-user totals.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed history across `/usage`, shared usage helpers, and prior maintainer-facing security/product review for this item.
